_about: v16.5 wave 1 fix round (notes/ux-build/w1-fix-AS-BUILT.md, built in work/xu1): the strings the fixes of the three wave 1 reviews added or changed. id -> {en, ru, note}. Read after every other v16.5 table (tools/make_ru_table.py, V165_FIX_HERE), so a changed Russian here wins. Terms: GLOSSARY.md. Edit by read-modify-write only.

construct.globe_curve.en: Switch to the plane to pick the curve
construct.globe_curve.ru: Переключитесь на плоскость, чтобы выбрать кривую
construct.globe_curve.note: rail-5: Intersect, Orthogonal, Touching and Hyperbolic on the Riemann sphere (their curves are picked in the plane). Chip line, 2 s.

construct.pick_point_on.ru: Выберите точку (на кривой: {c} или в любом месте)
construct.pick_point_on.note: user-6: the construction chip after the curve of Orthogonal or Hyperbolic is picked; {c} = the curve's name in the nominative («Окружность 1», «единичная окружность»), after «на кривой:» as elsewhere.

probe.teach.en: Hold and slide to read F(z)
probe.teach.note: user-4: the phone's scale chip, once a session for 8 s. The v16.5 plane piece's «Удерживайте и ведите палец, чтобы прочитать F(z)» was cut at 412 px before «F(z)», the point of it; this short form fits beside «2 / дел.».
